scenes.headline: How virtual heads fold back into plain GQA
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Eyelet! This attention layer trains with extra parts, then folds them away, so you serve ordinary grouped query attention.

scenes.text: Keep only two key value heads and half the query heads. Add two linear maps to win quality back, then multiply them into the weights.
scenes.say: The idea: keep two key value heads and half the query heads. Add two small linear maps to win quality back. Then multiply them into the weights.

steps.say: Start with eight physical query heads, half the usual count.
Premix gives each key value group its own matrix. Every query head goes through both, so eight become sixteen virtual heads.
Each group of eight virtual heads attends over one cached head. The cache holds just two.
Postmix adds a small low rank mix across the head outputs, so the two groups can share.

parts.say: Neither map is nonlinear. A query head times a Premix matrix...
is the input times their product, which you compute once. The same move pushes Postmix into the output weights.

left.title: As trained
items: Premix and Postmix as separate maps
left.say: As trained, the layer has eight query heads and two extra maps.

right.title: As served
right.say: As served, it is stock grouped query attention with sixteen query heads and two cached heads. No new kernel.

scenes.title: KV cache per token per layer
scenes.say: At the paper's one point seven billion shape, that is one kilobyte per token per layer, a quarter of the eight head setup.

scenes.label: largest gap between the trained layer and its folded twin
scenes.say: I ran the fold at that shape. In double precision the two graphs agree to round off. With a gate after Postmix, they do not.

scenes.text: The fold is exact and the cache is four times smaller. On quality it matches grouped query attention.
scenes.say: So: the fold is exact, and the cache is four times smaller. The quality margins are small and from single runs. Call it a match.

recap: Both maps fold into the weights
Serve plain GQA with 2 cached heads
scenes.say: Premix makes virtual queries, both maps fold away, and you serve plain grouped query attention.
